rows.quote: One was sourced from the FinnGen consortium (https://www.finngen.fi/en, Finngen-R12-Calculus of kidney and ureter), with 12, 999 cases and 486, 185 controls.

rows.quote: We systematically gathered summary-level data on mitochondrial gene methylation, expression, and protein abundance from molecular quantitative trait loci studies, and assessed genetic associations with nephrolithiasis, ureterolithiasis, and bladder calculus using data from the Million Veteran Program, UK Biobank, and FinnGen study.
rows.coder_note: Sentence names the discovery GWAS source; the dictionary has no row for it alone.
